info.title: Ride Archive core API
info.description: Core metadata, original preservation, GPX path parsing and attachment API. Owner comes from trusted configuration. Classification, metrics and query translation remain pending.

200.description: Byte-identical source reused; import occurrence recorded

requestBody.description: Raw original bytes; 1 byte to 10 MiB. File content is not validated as GPX.

post.summary: Parse preserved GPX without inferring observed evidence

422.description: Invalid GPX, unsupported geometry, or parser limits exceeded

get.summary: List parsed tracks/routes; empty before parsing

post.summary: Attach a parsed track/route with current entry revision

delete.summary: Unlink a path without deleting original evidence

original_filename.description: Filename from the first import occurrence.
